title: InteropFailure
description: Canonical failure record for any interop operation that could not be completed due to policy, grant, credential, or availability constraints. All five failure classes fail closed: the calling agent MUST NOT retry without external remediation. Every failure emits the corresponding operation-type LedgerEvent with allow=false.

failure_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for this failure record.

failure_class.description: Canonical failure class. tool_unavailable: the MCP tool or remote agent is not reachable or registered. grant_denied: no valid grant exists for the requested operation and scope. credential_revoked: the actor's credential or grant has been explicitly revoked. external_admin_required: the operation requires out-of-band human or admin approval before proceeding. policy_blocked: the policy fabric evaluated and explicitly denied this operation.

command_id.description: Optional reference to the OperationCommand that triggered this failure.

trust_boundary_id.description: Reference to the TrustBoundary at which the failure occurred.

grant_id.description: Optional reference to the Grant that was absent, expired, or revoked.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the operation failed.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the policy that produced or witnessed this failure.
